# Eject

> Stop paying to host your website. Move it to your agent for free.

Eject moves a simple website off a website builder. The move is $99 USD, once. You own the code. You can manage the site with a free ChatGPT account or any AI tool. Eject does not charge a monthly hosting fee. You still pay your domain registrar.

Eject takes simple marketing, portfolio, and landing sites on Webflow, Framer, Wix, and Squarespace, about 10 pages. Stores, member areas, and large CMS sites are out. Eject does not promise a visual match.

The public price is $99 USD. Checkout may be a waitlist. There is no second public price.
